h.gu: 6.1.1 દરેક Size માપીએ કે Accept/Reject નક્કી કરીએ?

body.en:
Start with a situation

In repeated production,inspection often needs a quick reliable limit decision rather than a displayed size for every part.

Definition

A limit gauge checks whether specified features lie within defined limit conditions;it normally does not display the actual size.

Understand the reason

GO and NO-GO are acceptance functions,not simply two colours.Their sizes,form,wear and use must follow the applicable gauge specification.

Example / application

A plug gauge checks a hole;ring/snap gauges check a shaft or outside feature.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A pass does not replace separate surface,location or material requirements.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Repeated productionમાં દરેક partનું displayed size નહિ,ઝડપી અને વિશ્વસનીય limit decision જરૂરી બને.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Limit gauge specified features defined limit conditionsમાં છે કે નહિ તપાસે;સામાન્ય રીતે actual size બતાવતું નથી.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

GO અને NO-GO acceptance functions છે,ફક્ત બે colours નહિ.તેના sizes,form,wear,use applicable gauge specification મુજબ હોય.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Plug gauge hole તપાસે;ring/snap gauges shaft કે outside feature તપાસે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Pass થવાથી અલગ surface,location કે material requirements દૂર નથી થતી.

body.en:
Definition

At the ideal workpiece limits,a hole GO corresponds to its smallest size(MMC) and NO-GO to its largest size(LMC).A shaft GO corresponds to its largest size(MMC),NO-GO to its smallest size(LMC).

Taylor principle:the GO gauge should check the maximum-material boundary in a full-form functional manner;NO-GO should check individual size elements where practicable.

Understand the reason

The practical gauge design includes manufacturing tolerance,wear allowance and the adopted standard.GO must pass as specified;NO-GO must not pass under the stated conditions without forcing.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Real gauge limits are not obtained by blindly copying the two workpiece limits;use the specified allocation and acceptance convention.

Quick check: Which hole condition is MMC?

Smallest permitted hole;it leaves the most material.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Ideal workpiece limits પર hole GO સૌથી નાના size(MMC),NO-GO સૌથી મોટા size(LMC)ને અનુસરે.Shaft GO સૌથી મોટા size(MMC),NO-GO સૌથી નાના size(LMC)ને અનુસરે.

Taylor principle:GO gaugeએ maximum-material boundary full-form functional રીતે તપાસવી;NO-GOએ શક્ય હોય ત્યાં individual size elements તપાસવા.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Practical gauge designમાં manufacturing tolerance,wear allowance,અપનાવેલો standard આવે.GO specified રીતે પસાર થાય;NO-GO stated conditionsમાં forcing વગર પસાર ન થાય.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Real gauge limits workpieceની બે limits આંધળી copy કરીને ન મળે;specified allocation અને acceptance convention લો.

જાતે વિચારો: Holeની કઈ Condition MMC?

સૌથી નાનું permitted hole;material સૌથી વધુ રહે.

body.en:
Definition

A plug gauge checks an internal feature with appropriately designed GO and NO-GO ends.

Construction:parts and purpose

A handle identifies the gauge and supports controlled use.

A full-form GO plug represents the specified functional boundary.

A NO-GO end uses the specified geometry for the upper-size check.

Marking/calibration records identify limits,material and wear criteria.

Working:sequence and reason

Check gauge identity,calibration/wear status and workpiece temperature.

Clean hole and gauge;remove chips and inspect burrs.

Apply GO in the specified alignment/depth with prescribed light force.

Try NO-GO only as the applicable procedure allows;do not force or rock it to obtain a desired result.

Record the decision and segregate uncertain/nonconforming parts.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A worn GO plug becomes smaller and can accept an undersize hole;wear checks therefore matter.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Plug gauge યોગ્ય designના GO અને NO-GO endsથી internal feature તપાસે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Handle gauge ઓળખાવે અને controlled use આપે.

Full-form GO plug specified functional boundary દર્શાવે.

NO-GO end upper-size check માટે specified geometry ધરાવે.

Marking/calibration records limits,material,wear criteria ઓળખાવે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Gauge identity,calibration/wear status અને workpiece temperature જુઓ.

Hole/gauge સાફ કરો;chips કાઢી burrs જુઓ.

GOને specified alignment/depthમાં prescribed light forceથી વાપરો.

NO-GO applicable procedure મુજબ લો;ઇચ્છિત result માટે force કે rocking ન કરો.

Decision નોંધો અને uncertain/nonconforming parts અલગ રાખો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Worn GO plug નાનો થતાં undersize hole accept કરી શકે;એટલે wear checks જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Definition

Ring and snap gauges check external dimensions;full ring contact and two-point snap contact have different functional coverage.

Construction:parts and purpose

A ring has a specified internal gauging surface around a shaft.

A snap gauge provides fixed/adjustable opposing contacts.

Separate GO/NO-GO openings represent the selected limits.

Setting standards and locks establish adjustable gauges where applicable.

Working:sequence and reason

Confirm shaft limits,gauge type and verified setting.

Clean and align the part without side loading.

Apply GO and NO-GO using the specified procedure and force.

For snap gauges,inspect required orientations/positions and recognise limited form coverage.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Wear enlarges a GO ring/opening and may accept an oversize shaft.A two-contact snap gauge is not a universal full-form check.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Ring અને snap gauges external dimensions તપાસે;full ring અને two-point snapનું functional coverage જુદું છે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Ringમાં shaftની આસપાસ specified internal gauging surface હોય.

Snap gauge fixed/adjustable opposing contacts આપે.

અલગ GO/NO-GO openings પસંદ limits દર્શાવે.

લાગુ હોય ત્યાં setting standards/locks adjustable gauge set કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Shaft limits,gauge type,verified setting જુઓ.

Clean કરી side loading વગર part align કરો.

Specified procedure/forceથી GO,NO-GO લો.

Snapમાં જરૂરી orientations/positions તપાસો અને limited form coverage સમજો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Wearથી GO ring/opening મોટું થઈ oversize shaft accept થઈ શકે.Two-contact snap universal full-form check નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Thread plug/ring gauges assess mating-related conditions of internal/external threads according to a specified standard.

Construction:parts and purpose

A thread plug serves an internal thread;thread ring serves an external thread.

GO form represents the specified functional mating condition.

NO-GO form checks the specified pitch-diameter/limit condition with its defined engagement.

Identification includes thread designation,class,standard and verified condition.

Working:sequence and reason

Identify diameter,pitch,hand,starts and tolerance class.

Clean and check damage,wear and calibration status.

Engage without cross-threading and follow the prescribed GO procedure.

Apply the standard-specific NO-GO engagement/turn rule and document the decision.

Remember / avoid this mistake

There is no universal NO-GO turn count for every thread system.Never invent a fixed two/three-turn rule without the governing standard.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Thread plug/ring gauges specified standard પ્રમાણે internal/external threadsની mating-related conditions તપાસે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Thread plug internal thread માટે,thread ring external thread માટે છે.

GO form specified functional mating condition દર્શાવે.

NO-GO form defined engagementથી specified pitch-diameter/limit condition તપાસે.

Identificationમાં thread designation,class,standard,verified condition આવે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Diameter,pitch,hand,starts,tolerance class ઓળખો.

Clean કરી damage,wear,calibration status જુઓ.

Cross-threading વગર engage કરી prescribed GO procedure લો.

Standard-specific NO-GO engagement/turn ruleથી decision નોંધો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

દરેક thread system માટે universal NO-GO turn count નથી.Governing standard વગર fixed two/three-turn rule ન બનાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Interchangeability means appropriately specified parts can be assembled/replaced without individual fitting while meeting function.

Selective assembly measures and groups parts into controlled bands,then matches compatible groups.

Example / application

If one process makes a wide spread,matching small shafts with suitable holes may control assembly clearance,but it needs identification,stock balance and traceability.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Selective assembly is planned matching,not hiding out-of-specification parts or changing requirements after measurement.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

યોગ્ય specified partsને individual fitting વગર assemble/replace કરી function મળે તે interchangeability.

Selective assemblyમાં parts માપી controlled bandsમાં group કરી compatible groups જોડીએ.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Processમાં મોટો spread હોય તો નાના shaftsને યોગ્ય holes સાથે match કરી clearance નિયંત્રિત થાય,પણ identification,stock balance,traceability જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Selective assembly planned matching છે;out-of-spec parts છુપાવવું કે માપ્યા પછી requirement બદલવી નહિ.

body.en:
Stepwise solution

  1. Obtain workpiece limits,material,feature length and functional requirements.
  2. Select gauge type and governing gauge/acceptance standard.
  3. Allocate gauge-maker tolerance and wear allowance using that standard,not an unlabelled percentage rule.
  4. Calculate new-gauge and wear/rejection limits;specify form,finish,hardness and identification.
  5. Plan calibration,setting,storage,force,temperature and decision rules.

Remember / avoid this mistake

The following example deliberately declares a conservative teaching allocation;it is not an ISO production gauge table.
body.gu:
એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Workpiece limits,material,feature length,functional requirements લો.
  2. Gauge type અને governing gauge/acceptance standard લો.
  3. તે standardથી gauge-maker tolerance,wear allowance ફાળવો;બિનઓળખી percentage rule નહિ.
  4. New-gauge અને wear/rejection limits ગણો;form,finish,hardness,identification આપો.
  5. Calibration,setting,storage,force,temperature,decision rules ગોઠવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આગળનો દાખલો ઇરાદાપૂર્વક conservative teaching allocation જાહેર કરે છે;તે ISO production gauge table નથી.

body.en:
Given

Hole20.000–20.020mm;assume gauge toleranceG=.002mm,GO wear allowanceW=.001mm and the following conservative internal allocation.

Stepwise solution

  1. New GO plug zone=[Dmin+W,Dmin+W+G]=[20.001,20.003]mm
  2. GO wear lower limit=Dmin=20.000mm
  3. NO-GO plug zone=[Dmax−G,Dmax]=[20.018,20.020]mm
  4. This inward allocation guards against certain false acceptances but can reject some truly conforming parts near the limits.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Use the explicitly agreed standard/decision plan for real design;this assumed allocation is not universal and does not eliminate uncertainty.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Hole20.000–20.020mm;gauge tolerance G=.002mm,GO wear allowance W=.001mm અને નીચેની conservative internal allocation માનો.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. New GO plug zone=[Dmin+W,Dmin+W+G]=[20.001,20.003]mm
  2. GO wear lower limit=Dmin=20.000mm
  3. NO-GO plug zone=[Dmax−G,Dmax]=[20.018,20.020]mm
  4. આ inward allocation કેટલીક false acceptances સામે guard આપે,પણ limits નજીકના કેટલાક સાચા conforming parts reject થઈ શકે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Real designમાં agreed standard/decision plan લો;આ assumed allocation universal નથી અને uncertainty દૂર કરતી નથી.

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Define limit gauging→state MMC/LMC and Taylor principle→label GO/NO-GO contacts→working and wear direction→limitations.
  2. In gauge-design numericals,write the adopted tolerance/wear allocation first,then compute and label new-gauge and wear limits separately.
Quick check: Does a passing GO gauge give exact size?

No.It gives the specified limit-function result,not a numerical size.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Limit gauging define→MMC/LMC,Taylor principle→GO/NO-GO contacts→Working,wear direction→limitations.
  2. Gauge-design numericalમાં પહેલા adopted tolerance/wear allocation લખો,પછી new-gauge અને wear limits અલગ label કરી ગણો.
જાતે વિચારો: GO Gauge Pass એટલે Exact Size મળે?

ના.Specified limit-function result મળે,numerical size નહિ.

terms.en: These are ideal workpiece boundaries;actual gauge limits need the stated gauge standard,tolerance,wear and decision plan.
terms.gu: આ ideal workpiece boundaries છે;actual gauge limits માટે stated standard,tolerance,wear,decision plan જોઈએ.

a.en: MMC:smallest hole,subject to gauge design allowances.
a.gu: MMC:સૌથી નાનું hole,gauge design allowances લાગુ પડે.

a.en: MMC:largest shaft,subject to gauge design allowances.
a.gu: MMC:સૌથી મોટો shaft,gauge design allowances લાગુ પડે.

q.en: Explain GO/NO-GO and Taylor principle with hole/shaft MMC.
q.gu: Hole/Shaft MMC સાથે GO/NO-GO,Taylor Principle સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain plug,ring,snap and thread gauges with working and wear risks.
q.gu: Plug,Ring,Snap,Thread Gauges Working અને wear risks સાથે સમજાવો.

q.en: Describe gauge-design steps and why the allocation standard must be stated.
q.gu: Gauge-design steps અને allocation standard જણાવવું શા માટે જરૂરી તે સમજાવો.

q.en: For hole20.000–20.020mm,G.002mm,W.001mm use GO[Dmin+W,Dmin+W+G],NO-GO[Dmax−G,Dmax];find new limits and GO wear lower limit.
q.gu: Hole20.000–20.020mm,G.002mm,W.001mm માટે GO[Dmin+W,Dmin+W+G],NO-GO[Dmax−G,Dmax]થી new limits,GO wear lower limit શોધો.
